```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(arrow)
library(collapse)
```

This document uses functions that utilize duckdb's ability to filter the SDM data before it is read into R for efficiency improvements. 

This document uses the IUCN lookup and threat category data created in the chi repository. It connects IUCN status to AquaX data using the Aphia ID, which is a unique identifier for marine species in the World Register of Marine Species (WoRMS). github: https://github.com/nceas-range-shifts/chi_shifts/tree/main/_data/iucn_redlist_2026 

```{r}
iucn_lookup <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nceas-range-shifts/chi_shifts/ab9cd09931a4ce5c12d0bcd2984595d6522ed158/_data/iucn_redlist_2026/iucn_worms_aphia_id_complete.csv")
```

```{r}
iucn_new_cat <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nceas-range-shifts/chi_shifts/refs/heads/main/_data/iucn_redlist_2026/iucn_species_assessments.csv")
```


# IUCN threatened species

```{r}
# Filter the iucn_lookup for species with an SDM
iucn_lookup_sdm <- iucn_lookup %>% filter(aquax == "SDM")
```

```{r}
# Filter iucn categories for threatened species (CR, EN, VU) and near threatened (NT) species
iucn_threatened <- iucn_new_cat %>% 
  filter(redlist_category %in% c("CR","EN", "VU", "NT"))
```

```{r}
# Merge in the iucn_lookup_sdm to get the AphiaID for the threatened species
aphiaid_threatened <- inner_join(iucn_lookup_sdm, iucn_threatened, by = c("iucn_assessment_id" = "assessment_id")) 
```

```{r}
# Get aphiaids for the threatened species
aphiaid_threat <- unique(aphiaid_threatened$aphia_id)
```

## Prep AquaX data
We'll be working with the 1,323 at-risk aphiaids

```{r}
# read in meta data on the aquax species
load("/home/shares/data-aquax/META_02122025.Rdata")
```

```{r}
meta_clean <- META %>% 
  mutate(worms_name = tolower(ScientificName)) %>% 
  select(!ScientificName) %>% 
  # simplify for now for easier viewing
  select(AphiaID, SPID, worms_name, GROUP, NR_CR, range_pixels, SDM)
```

```{r}
spp_fs <- list.files('/home/shares/data-aquax/SDM',
                     full.names = TRUE)

df <- data.frame(f = spp_fs) %>%
    mutate(fsize = file.size(f),
           aphiaid = str_extract(basename(f), '[0-9]+') %>% as.integer()) %>%
    left_join(META, by = c('aphiaid' = 'AphiaID'))
```

```{r}
# Filter for the AphiaID of the threatend species - get 1,047 threatened species and 276 non-threatened species with SDMs
df_threatened <- df %>% 
  filter(aphiaid %in% aphiaid_threat)
```

```{r}
test_f <- read_parquet("/home/shares/data-aquax/SDM/FINAL_EMSDM_EMMEAN_SP_1017389.parquet")
```

# Run full sample for entry pixels

```{r}
# Function for pixels that were not present in the current time period and are present in climate scenario (entry to pixel)
# Juliette - you could probably just get rid of the "AND Current < cutoff" statement that filters for only species that were not present in the current time period
# You would still want the flag to later sum up the number of pixels that are in that cell (could change to binary = 1 instead of entry = 1)

# Get all entry pixels (pixel by pixel) using duckdb to filter first
extract_all_entry_pixels_df_db <- function(id, df, s) {
    spp_filter <- df %>% filter(aphiaid == id)
  
    if (nrow(spp_filter) == 0) {
      warning("No rows found for aphiaid: ", id)
      return(NULL)
  }

  # Create database connection
  con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
  # Ensure connection is closed 
  on.exit(DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  # Write query to round x and y to 3 decimal places and filter for scenario pixels at or above cutoff threshold
   query_str <- paste0("SELECT ROUND(x, 3) AS x, ROUND(y, 3) AS y, ", paste(s, collapse = ", "), 
                      " FROM read_parquet('", spp_filter$f, "')",
                      " WHERE ", paste(s, collapse = ", "), " >= cutoff AND Current < cutoff")

 # Run query and filter for scenario pixels below current cutoff threshold and above cutoff threshold
    spp_entry <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, query_str) 

  # Set option for if there are no pixels below current cutoff threshold and above the cutoff threshold
    if (nrow(spp_entry) == 0) {
        warning("No entry pixels for aphiaid: ", id)
        # Return NA to track no pixels above threshold
      return(data.frame(x = NA, y = NA, MRGID = NA, entry = 0))
    } else {
  
  # Flag the pixels for entry
    spp_entry_pxls <- spp_entry %>% 
      mutate(entry = 1) 
  
  return(spp_entry_pxls)
  }
}

```

```{r}
# 185 seconds
system.time({
  spp_entry_pxl_rcp45_2050_list <- parallel::mclapply(aphiaid_threat, FUN = extract_all_entry_pixels_df_db, 
                                       df = df_threatened, 
                                       s = "RCP45_2050",
                                       mc.cores = 30)
})
```

```{r}
entry_rcp45_df <- bind_rows(spp_entry_pxl_rcp45_2050_list) %>% 
  # drop entry = 0 (no entry pixels for aphiaid)
  filter(entry == 1)
```

```{r}
# Sum by XY cell, using collapse (counting the number of species in a pixel)
system.time({
entry_rcp45_sum_df <- entry_rcp45_df %>% 
  fgroup_by(x, y) %>% 
  fcount() %>% 
  mutate(scenario = "RCP45_2050") %>% 
  rename(n_entry_pxls = N)
})
```

```{r}
# Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_tile(data = entry_rcp45_sum_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = n_entry_pxls)) 
```
